definition: The standard applied and was followed. Every list needs this value; without it there is no denominator.
There was not enough to go on: missing, incomplete, unreadable, unverifiable or not yet available.
What was supplied conflicts with something else that is known.
A specific rule, policy, threshold or standard was breached or engaged.
The matter does not fall within the boundary of what is being decided. Lowest coverage in the corpus; may collapse into rule_conflict.
An assessment of risk, consequence or trajectory drove the outcome rather than a rule.
Resources, budget, volume or cost to serve shaped the decision.
A deadline, window, sequence or statutory clock shaped the outcome.
The outcome was determined by someone outside the deciding organisation.
Beyond the decider delegation: referred, escalated, or stood aside.
None of the above. Free text required, and the rate is monitored.
